title: Implement operator key rotation workflow
description:
Document and implement key rotation: (1) generate new keypair with keygen tool, (2) update config to point to new key file, (3) publish a signed announcement article on a designated group (usenet.ipfs.keyrotation) with old key signing the new public key. Implement the announcement article format and the transit command to publish it. Artifact: docs/key_rotation.md and transit/src/cli/key_rotate.rs.

Acceptance:
- Rotation announcement article signed with old key, contains new public key
- Announcement article stored in IPFS and appended to usenet.ipfs.keyrotation group log
- docs/key_rotation.md explains the process step by step
- Operator can rotate without downtime (old key still valid until announcement propagates)
